description: This header file declares functions and includes related to spark logic control in an engine management system, such as handling spark events, initialization, and querying spark-related parameters.

methods.name: isInjectionEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether fuel injection is enabled based on engine parameters.

methods.name: handleSpark
methods.description: Handles spark event logic, possibly activating or deactivating spark based on engine state.

methods.name: initSparkLogic
methods.description: Initializes spark logic components, potentially setting up shared logging.

methods.name: turnSparkPinHigh
methods.description: Sets the spark ignition pin to high state, triggering spark ignition.

methods.name: turnSparkPinLow
methods.description: Sets the spark ignition pin to low state, ending spark ignition.

methods.name: getNumberOfSparks
methods.description: Returns the number of sparks per cycle based on the ignition mode.

methods.name: getCoilDutyCycle
methods.description: Calculates and returns the duty cycle for the ignition coil based on RPM.
